    AND ALL OTHER OCCUPANTS IN POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES AT:

PROPERTY ADDRESS: 333 Spruce Avenue, Unit 8B, Glendale, CA 91201

PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that the rent on the above-described premises
occupied by you, in the amount of $1,500.00, for the
period from December 01, 2025 to
December 28, 2025, is now due and unpaid.

YOU ARE HEREBY REQUIRED to pay the said rent in full within THREE (3)
DAYS after service of this notice, or to vacate and surrender
possession of the premises.

Rent must be paid to: Bay Area Housing Inc.
Address: 555 Market Street, Oakland, CA 94612
Telephone: (510) 555-3456

Payment may be made in person at our office.

Payment may also be made at the following financial institution
located within five (5) miles of the rental property:
    Bank: Wells Fargo Bank
    Address: 200 Financial Ave, San Francisco, CA 94102

the premises within three (3) days after service of this notice
(excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and judicial holidays), the undersigned
will institute legal proceedings against you to recover possession of
the premises and to recover rents and damages.

NOTICE OF FORFEITURE: Your failure to pay the rent due or vacate the
